author: Quin Henshaw
name: com.qhenshaw.playtestfeedback
description: In-game playtest feedback tool. Players press F8 to pause the game, write feedback, pick a category, snip and draw on a screenshot, and send it with game version, system info, logs and custom game state to a Discord channel through a webhook.

samples.description: Shows how to attach game-specific state (player position, checkpoint, inventory...) to every feedback report.
